decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up approach to left toy car; assign cars to white, cameras to blue, pens to red. Raise and tilt left wrist gradually.
Advance left hand above gold vehicle while completing downward grasp orientation; keep clearance before descent.
Slow descent toward gold vehicle, correcting the downward orientation; use next wrist view to refine grasp depth and alignment.
Align gold vehicle between pads, descend the final short distance, and close the left gripper. Retention remains to be checked after lifting.
Lift the gold object with gripper closed, then translate toward the white basket above its front rim; verify that it stays between the pads.
Gold tank is retained. Center it inside the white basket and release with the hand stationary above the basket.
Forward motion reached a continuity limit. The tank is already over the white basket, so release here, then retreat upward and back with a gentler wrist tilt.
Tank is visibly inside white basket. Move above the aqua vehicle, restoring a downward grasp and aligning the jaws across its body.
Lower toward aqua car and refine yaw so the pads close across the narrow sides rather than along its length.
Center the aqua car between the pads using the wrist view, descend the last 2 cm, and close before testing retention.
Lift the aqua car with the gripper closed and start the transfer toward the white basket, checking retention in the next view.
Aqua car remains between the pads. Carry it toward the white basket while tilting the wrist forward to preserve reach margin.
Lower the retained aqua car into the white basket, open to release, and lift clear. Then inspect both vehicles before moving to cameras.
Both vehicles are inside white. Approach the left black camera from above, keeping the left hand on its own side and aligning the jaws across the camera.
Replan from the interrupted pose with smaller yaw increments. Move the open left gripper above the left camera and inspect alignment before closing.
Refine the left camera grasp from the wrist image: move slightly forward, lower gradually, and align the pads across its narrow dimension.
Center the left camera between the pads, descend to its sides, and close. A subsequent lift will test retention.
Lift the left camera with the gripper closed, then turn gradually toward a forward-tilted basket approach while staying on the left side.
Camera is retained in the left gripper. Finish the forward wrist tilt and move it above the left half of the blue basket.
Place the first camera inside blue and withdraw the left hand. Begin raising the right elbow-up arm for the second camera.
First camera has been released into blue. Withdraw left toward its home side while moving the right hand above the remaining camera in a downward approach.
The previous chunk moved neither arm. Reduce the initial left withdrawal increments to preserve IK continuity; continue the right camera approach.
Withdraw the empty left arm further. Rotate the right jaws across the remaining camera and lower modestly for a closer alignment view.
Refine the right camera alignment and close at its sides; bring the empty left arm close to origin. Retention will be assessed after a short lift.
Lift the second camera and start rotating toward the blue basket, maintaining closed grip. Finish the empty left arm's gentle return to origin.
The camera is retained. Bring it over the right half of blue, finishing yaw alignment and then tilting forward to avoid excessive reach.
Move the second camera slightly farther inside blue, release it, and retreat above the rim. Keep the left arm at origin.
Both cameras are visibly inside blue. Retreat the right hand above the central pen and restore a downward approach before rotating the jaws.
Rotate the right gripper so it will pinch across the central pen, while lowering slowly and keeping the grasp point on the right side of center.
Complete the across-pen jaw alignment and approach its sides slowly, leaving the gripper open for a final visual depth check.
Make a small lateral correction, lower the pads to the pen, and close the right gripper without translating during closure.
Lift the pen with the right gripper closed, then start moving toward red with a modest forward tilt. Check retention in the next view.
The first pen stays between the pads. Transfer above the red basket, preserving its horizontal orientation and keeping clearance over the rim.
Lower the first pen inside red, release with a stationary hand, and lift clear to approach the remaining pen.
The first pen is inside red. Move above the remaining pen, restore a downward approach, and rotate the jaws across its diagonal shaft.
Descend gradually above the final pen, correcting its shaft alignment. Keep the gripper open until its pads are at the pen's sides.
Center the final pen between the pads with a small lateral correction, descend the last short distance, then close without moving during closure.
Lift the final pen to test retention, then move toward red while tilting forward for basket clearance. Maintain a fully closed grip.
The final pen is retained. Center it inside red, lower slightly, open to release, and begin withdrawing without disturbing the other pen.
Both pens are inside red and released. Withdraw the open right hand upward and back, gradually unwinding its wrist to return to origin without disturbing the baskets.
Continue the open right arm's return, unwinding the wrist and moving back toward its home workspace. All six objects appear contained in their category baskets.
Return the empty right arm to its initial pose with small continuous increments; leave both grippers open while the sorted objects settle.
